title: Kitab-e-Nikah

couple.tagline: The Auspicious Royal Nikah Celebration Of
couple.invitationMessage: With the divine grace of Almighty Allah (SWT) and the cherished prayers of our beloved parents and elders, we cordially invite you to witness the sacred signing of the Nikahnama as our children unite in marriage.
couple.urduGreeting: Aapki pur-khuloos shirkat aur duayein hamari khushiyon ko dobala karengi.

venue.name: The Royal Heritage Qasr
venue.address: Gomti Riverfront Heritage Boulevard, Hazratganj, Lucknow 226001

storyMessage: In the historic city of Tehzeeb and timeless grace, our stories met on the illuminated golden pages of destiny. With the heartfelt blessings and prayers of our elders, we sign our lifelong covenant of devotion, tranquility, and faith.

events.name: Majlis-e-Dua, Manjha & Mehendi
events.description: An auspicious gathering of heartfelt Quranic duas, fresh marigold ubtan ceremonies, and intricate Awadhi bridal henna artistry surrounded by family warmth.

events.name: Sacred Nikahnama Signing & Solemnization (Ijab-o-Qubool)
events.description: Signing of the sacred Nikahnama parchment, recitation of Khutbah-e-Nikah, and solemn vows before family elders in an atmosphere of reverence and grace.

events.name: Rukhsati & Royal Dawat-e-Walima Banquet
events.dressCode: Black Tie / Royal Awadhi Velvet & Gold
events.description: Tender parental prayers under the holy Quran followed by a grand celebratory Awadhi feast featuring legendary Lucknowi delicacies and live Sufi ensemble.

verse.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَجَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا لِيَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا
verse.translation: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her.
verse.propheticDua: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
verse.propheticDuaTranslation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness and eternal love.
